1. Introduction

SIGNALANALYTICS.AI LTD is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal and business data. This Privacy and Data Policy explains how information is collected, used, stored and protected when you visit our website or interact with our services.

2. Scope

This policy applies to visitors to www.signalanalytics.ai, users who submit information through our forms and clients who engage with SIGNALANALYTICS.AI LTD for demonstrations, analytics, consulting or software-related services.

3. Information we collect

  • Contact information such as name, email address, company name and message content submitted through forms or email
  • Limited technical and usage data such as IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and time spent on site
  • Business data supplied by clients where required for agreed project delivery

4. How we use information

  • Respond to correspondence and enquiries
  • Provide demonstrations, analytics, consulting or software services
  • Improve site performance, reliability and security
  • Support agreed project delivery

We do not sell personal data and we do not use client business data outside the scope of the agreed work.

5. Legal basis

We process data under one or more applicable legal bases, including legitimate interest, consent, contract and legal obligation where required under UK data protection law.

6. Analytics and cookies

This website may use analytics tools, cookies and basic tracking technologies to understand website usage, monitor performance and improve the user experience. These may include Google Analytics and server logs.

7. Data storage and hosting

Where data storage is required, information may be securely hosted on our cloud infrastructure or deployed within the client's own cloud, private environment or internal systems, depending on project requirements and client needs.

Solutions may also be configured so that business data remains entirely within the client's own environment where required.

8. Third-party providers

We may use trusted third-party providers such as cloud hosting providers, analytics providers, software platforms and email systems where necessary to operate our website and services, subject to appropriate security and confidentiality controls.

9. Retention and security

We retain information only for as long as necessary for correspondence, service delivery, business administration or legal purposes. Reasonable technical and organisational measures are used to protect data against unauthorised access, misuse, loss or disclosure.

10. Your rights

Under UK data protection law, you may request access to your data, correction of inaccurate data, deletion of data, restriction of processing or withdrawal of consent where applicable.

            SignalPulse

            An early read, using real signals. Built from limited inputs, external data and pattern-based modelling. Enough to identify likely drivers and support early decisions.

            A Signal build

            A connected system, built on full internal data. With full workflow, systems and financial data, the picture becomes more precise, more granular and continuous.

            What you've just seen

            A first read of where complexity is creating drag. Built from your inputs. Enough to identify where to focus and act immediately.

            What a full diagnostic measures

            A deeper view across five connected layers: Company Financials, Portfolio structure, Process and ways of working, Systems and data flows, Commercial and operational impact.

            What organisations typically uncover

            • Higher complexity cost than expected
            • Hidden drag across systems, approvals and manual work
            • Far greater precision once real data is connected
            • Quick wins that weren't visible before, with disproportionate impact

            Complexity creates a cost that compounds.
            Reducing it creates an efficiency dividend that compounds in return.
